compiled:
📰 General

Trump Imposes 25% Tariff on Nations Trading with Iran Amid Protests •

President Donald Trump declared a 25% tariff on any country engaging in trade with Iran, citing concerns over Tehran’s suppression of ongoing protests. The announcement follows repeated warnings to Iran not to use force against demonstrators. The United States has accused Iranian security forces of using excessive force during demonstrations across the country. This move represents a significant escalation of economic pressure on Iran, targeting nations that continue to maintain commercial ties.

🌍 World

Argentine Ex-General Accuses Israelis of Starting Patagonia Wildfires •

Retired Argentine military general César Milani and several opposition figures disseminated a conspiracy theory alleging Israeli forces, specifically using an IDF grenade, ignited a wildfire in Patagonia. The claims, presented on Sunday, suggest deliberate action targeting the region’s natural landscape. This assertion stems from a broader antisemitic narrative circulating within the group. Authorities have not yet commented on the specific allegations, focusing instead on investigating the origin of the fire.

🦅 US

Nikki Glaser’s Unscripted Golden Globes Monologue Delights and Divides Hollywood

Nikki Glaser hosted the 2026 Golden Globes, marking her return for a second consecutive year. Her opening monologue featured self-deprecating humor, referencing her previous hosting experience. Glaser’s remarks included jokes about her awkwardness and the event’s traditional formality. The monologue generated both laughter and criticism from viewers and industry figures. Glaser’s unconventional approach contrasted with the typically polished tone of the awards show.

💰 Business

Dow Rises on Nvidia Gains, Biotech Stocks Face Continued Selling Pressure •

The Dow Jones Industrial Average experienced a positive movement today, largely driven by increased activity in Nvidia stock. Investor interest in the semiconductor giant fueled the upward trend. Conversely, several biotech companies continued to see significant selling pressure, with prices declining across the sector. Market analysts attribute the divergence to varying investor sentiment regarding technological innovation versus pharmaceutical developments.

💻 Technology

IKEA’s Smart ‘Donut Lamp’ Launches, Offering Smooth Color Transitions •

IKEA has unveiled the Varmblixt, a smart version of its popular ‘donut lamp,’ during CES 2026. The lamp utilizes a smooth, gradual color transition system, unlike abrupt changes found in other smart lighting products. Developed in collaboration with a technology partner, the Varmblixt integrates seamlessly into existing smart home ecosystems. It’s designed to create a calming and adaptable ambiance within a user’s living space.

🎭 Entertainment

T.K. Carter, ‘Punky Brewster’ Actor, Dies at 69 – A Television Icon Passes •

T.K. Carter, best known for his roles in the science fiction film “The Thing” and the television series “Punky Brewster,” died on Friday at the age of 69. He passed away at his home in Duarte, California, according to his representatives. Authorities have confirmed that no foul play is suspected in his death. Carter’s career spanned several decades within the entertainment industry, leaving a notable mark on 1980s television.

🏅 Sports

Packers Exploring Head Coach Matt LaFleur Extension Following Wild Card Loss •

The Green Bay Packers are reportedly considering an extension for head coach Matt LaFleur following their defeat to the Chicago Bears in the NFC Divisional Round. Discussions regarding LaFleur’s future with the team are expected to begin in the near term. The loss to Chicago significantly impacted the Packers’ playoff aspirations. The organization is evaluating LaFleur’s performance and future strategy within the team’s long-term plans. Details of the potential extension negotiations remain undisclosed at this time.

🔬 Science

Scientists Stunned by Unexpected Glowing Shock Wave Around Dying Star •

Astronomers have observed a remarkably bright and sustained shock wave emanating from a recently deceased star, a phenomenon previously unseen in stellar remnants. The glowing gases, primarily hydrogen and helium, are being propelled outwards by a powerful, unidentified force near the star’s former core. Researchers believe the shock wave’s intensity suggests a previously unknown mechanism is at play in the cooling process of these stellar corpses. Further investigation is underway to determine the source of this unusual energy release and understand its implications for our understanding of stellar evolution.

🩺 Health

Cognitive Decline Reversed? Study Identifies 8 Habits Linked to Remarkable Senior Brain Health •

Researchers have identified eight common activities performed by older adults without needing reminders as indicators of strong cognitive function. The study, based on anecdotal evidence from individuals over 65, suggests consistent engagement in these activities is associated with robust memory and recall. These activities include remembering daily routines, locating misplaced items, and managing multiple conversations simultaneously. The findings highlight the importance of continued mental stimulation and everyday tasks in maintaining cognitive health during aging.
